about: The universal order of an item description, shared by every locale. `categories` sorts every fragment key: the first category with a matching prefix wins (a prefix ending in '.' matches that family, any other prefix the key itself or its sub-keys), so the more specific categories come first. `queue` is the description, slot by slot, in reading order: identity, tier, a random pick, a random pick, a random pick, wear, stolen - then the player hint, its own paragraph after one blank line. A random slot draws one fragment from the categories it lists that still have fragments and room under their `max` (the cap counts every slot of the description, so a fragment or category is never repeated past it); the draw is seeded by the item, so one item always reads the same. The hint slot says what to do with the piece (hints.json and the locale's hints.csv): the piece's state first (quest, unidentified, cursed, broken, tier, sigil, made), else its base item's hint; and, for what a writ pays silver for, a second sentence - the guild's when the character is in one (facts.guild).

categories.title: Вещь + тип брони + материал / вещь + материал / одежда + цвет / вещь
Ремесло: качество, клеймо, наследие, перековка, заточка
Редкость + сигил + набор / редкость + сигил / редкость + набор / редкость
Подсказка игроку: что делать с вещью (последний абзац, белым)
Вне очереди: квестовое (оно — в подсказке), отдельная фраза окраски (цвет одежды — в первой фразе), привязка, призыв, памятная вещь, останки
